Raising chickens for meat has changed the way we look at food. 🐓❤️ It’s not just about putting food on the table. It’s about knowing where it came from, how it was raised, and the life it lived. We believe that if we’re going to raise animals for food, we have a responsibility to give them the best life we can. Fresh air. Sunshine. Room to roam. A life worth living. ❤️ Our goal isn’t just to produce our own food. It’s to raise it with care, respect, and purpose. And there’s something incredibly rewarding about that. 🌱 Follow Family First Farmstead as we learn to become more self-sufficient, one step at a time.
